result.summary: The home screen is mostly intact; the only notable visual problem is a profile/account control in the header that looks empty and has an unexplained red status dot.

issues.description: The top-right circular header control is almost blank (very light gray on white) with only a small red badge, so it looks unfinished or like a missing avatar/icon.
issues.suggestion: Add a clear profile or notification icon (and optional user photo) so the control is recognizable and the red indicator has context.
